message: You know that feeling when you finally feel like you've got it together? 🤗 The other day, I was rummaging through our closet and stumbled upon our go-bags, which I had packed ages ago. It felt so good to see them there, ready to roll at a moment’s notice! I even took a moment to refresh the snacks and check the water bottles. It’s such a comfort knowing I’m a little more prepared now. Has anyone else had a moment like this? What’s your go-to tip for staying ready?
